9: # Supabase Pricing
10: 
11: > Start for free, scale as you grow. Pay only for what you use.
12: 
13: Supabase offers four plans: Free, Pro, Team, and Enterprise. All plans include unlimited API requests. Projects on paid plans aren't paused for inactivity.
14: 
15: ## How billing works
16: 
17: Supabase uses organization-based billing. You choose a plan (Pro, Team, or Enterprise) for your organization, then each project within it runs on its own compute instance. The plan subscription covers platform features and usage quotas. Compute is billed separately per project.
18: 
19: Pro and Team plans include $10/month in compute credits, which covers one Micro instance. Additional projects each add their own compute cost. For example, a Pro org with 2 projects on Micro compute costs: $25 (plan) + $10 (project 1) + $10 (project 2) - $10 (credits) = $35/month.
20: 
21: For current pricing, visit https://supabase.com/pricing.
22: 
23: ## Database-only projects
24: 
25: A Supabase project can be used as a standalone Postgres database. Connect with psql, Prisma, Drizzle, or any Postgres client or ORM using the project's connection string. Auth, Storage, Realtime, and Edge Functions are included in every project but optional. Unused products cost nothing.

247: ### What happens if I cancel my subscription?
248: 
249: The organization is allocated credits for unused time during the billing month. Those credits can be used for other projects.

251: ### How can I track my usage?
252: 
253: You can track your organization's usage at any time on the [usage page](https://supabase.com/dashboard/org/_/usage) in the dashboard, which shows how each project is tracking against your plan's limits. Your upcoming invoice on the [billing page](https://supabase.com/dashboard/org/_/billing) updates as you go, and organizations on the Pro Plan or above can use the [Spend cap](https://supabase.com/docs/guides/platform/cost-control) to control costs.
254: 
255: ### What if I need one project for development and one for production?
256: 
257: You can create two projects, one for development and one for production — the Free Plan includes two free projects. You can also use [Branching](https://supabase.com/docs/guides/deployment/branching), available on the Pro Plan and above, to run a separate development environment off your production project.

Based on Supabase's official pricing page ([https://supabase.com/pricing](https://supabase.com/pricing)), here are the answers comparing the Free and Pro plans:

---

### 1. Monthly Base Prices and Included Projects

- **Free Plan**:
  - **Base Price**: **$0 / month** (or "from $0/month").
  - **Included Projects**: **2 active projects** are included. You can create up to 2 active projects, with an unlimited number of paused projects.
- **Pro Plan**:
  - **Base Price**: **$25 / month** (or "from $25/month").
  - **Included Projects**: Includes **$10/month in compute credits**, which covers **1 project** on a Micro compute instance. Additional projects are billed for their own compute instances (e.g., $10/month for each additional Micro instance).

---

### 2. Storage and Bandwidth Egress Limits

| Metric | Free Plan | Pro Plan |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Database Storage** | **500 MB** database size per project (Shared CPU • 500 MB RAM) | **8 GB** disk size per project included (General Purpose disk) |
| **File Storage** | **1 GB** file storage included (Max file upload size: 50 MB) | **100 GB** file storage included (Max file upload size: 500 GB) |
| **Bandwidth Egress** | **5 GB** egress included (+ **5 GB** cached egress) | **250 GB** egress included (+ **250 GB** cached egress) |

---

### 3. Pro Plan Overage Rates (Extra Charges)

When spend caps are turned off on the Pro plan, extra usage beyond the included quotas is billed at the following rates:

- **Additional Database Storage**:
  - **General Purpose Disk**: **$0.125 per GB** (beyond the 8 GB per project included).
  - *(Note: High Performance disk is also listed at $0.195 per GB).*
- **Additional File Storage**:
  - **$0.0213 per GB** (beyond the 100 GB included).
- **Additional Bandwidth Egress**:
  - **Egress**: **$0.09 per GB** (beyond the 250 GB included).
  - **Cached Egress**: **$0.03 per GB** (beyond the 250 GB included).

---

### 4. Auto-Pause Rules and Active Project Limits (Free Plan)

- **Auto-Pause Rules**:
  - Free projects are **automatically paused after 1 week of inactivity**.
  - Users may pause and unpause projects manually at any time; there is no limit on the number of paused projects you can maintain.
  - Projects on paid plans are never paused for inactivity.
- **Active Project Limits**:
  - **Limit of 2 active projects**.

---

### 5. Backup Retention and Log Retention Periods (Pro Plan)

- **Backup Retention Period**:
  - **7 days** (Daily backups stored for 7 days).
  - *(Optional add-on: Point-in-Time Recovery / PITR is available for $100 per month per 7 days of retention).*
- **Log Retention Period**:
  - **7 days** (Applies to API & Database logs as well as Auth Audit Logs).

---
